summary: Russian forces struck a shopping center in Dnipro and a passenger bus in Horlivka's Mykytivskyi district, wounding 11 including two children. Multiple Shahed and recon drone attacks hit Fastiv, Kyiv region, and Dnipro city simultaneously. The US preliminarily approved a $2.68B air defense package for Ukraine including S-300 Clone and GAM-67 missiles.
key_points: Russian Geran-2s struck radar stations in Kharkiv region and the START command post at Vesnianka airfield in Mykolaiv region (Source: @tass_agency/396210).

US gave preliminary approval for $2.68B air defense and munitions package to Ukraine including S-300 Clone, GAM-67 missiles, ITEL 1.5 launchers, RPS 202 anti-drone radars (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33366).
Shahed drones struck Fastiv twice targeting energy/rail infrastructure; another hit Dnipro city requiring shelter-in-place (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75173, @kpszsu/79040).
Lithuania MFA received intelligence Russia preparing large-scale false-flag hybrid operation; NATO briefed on scenarios (Source: @eRadarrua/114484).

Recon drones detected from Bryansk Oblast toward Chernihiv, from south toward Kyiv (Chabany/Bila Tserkva), and from Black Sea toward Odesa region (Source: @kpszsu/79034, @kpszsu/79024, @kpszsu/79008).

Russians struck a shopping center in Dnipro causing fire; casualties unknown. Also struck passenger bus in Horlivka wounding 11 including two children (Source: @UkraineNow/84190, @tass_agency/396220).
EU to allocate additional €3.3B for Ukrainian missile and drone procurement; Zelensky displayed new Shahed interceptor drone (Source: @UkraineNow/84177, @UkraineNow/84187).

sections.threat_assessment: Russia is conducting a multi-axis aerial campaign combining Shahed drones, Geran-2s, cruise missiles, and ballistic missiles targeting energy infrastructure, rail nodes, and civilian sites across Dnipropetrovsk, Kyiv, Kherson, and Sumy regions. The expansion of Shahed production in Alabuga's 42,000 m² underground facilities suggests sustained high-tempo drone warfare. Lithuania's warning of Russian false-flag hybrid operations adds a non-kinetic dimension requiring NATO vigilance. The $2.68B US air defense package, if finalized, could partially offset the aerial threat but delivery timelines remain uncertain.
sections.regional_response: The EU committed €3.3B for Ukrainian missile and drone procurement following Zelensky's display of new interceptor capabilities. Trump signed the Graham-initiated sanctions bill with potential 100% tariffs on countries buying Russian oil and gas. Ukrainian military medical evacuation expertise is being shared with Sweden including NRC MAUL ground robot operations, with Swedish Gen. Klasson personally engaging. Odesa TCC abuse case resulted in a 7-year sentence, addressing internal accountability concerns.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian force posture shows simultaneous kinetic operations across multiple fronts: KaB launches toward Hlukhiv, recon drones from Bryansk to Chernihiv, and Geran-2 strikes on Kharkiv radar and Vesnianka airfield command post. The Chernobyl-zone drone launch toward Bragin indicates use of contaminated territory as a staging area. Dnipro city drone overflight and Fastiv energy infrastructure targeting suggest Russian efforts to degrade Ukrainian logistical and energy resilience. Ballistic missile activity toward Kherson/Pivdenne warrants continued monitoring of southern front dynamics.
